missing.what: Warehouses read the bucket directly (BigQuery LOAD DATA from GCS, Snowflake via a storage integration)
missing.why: For BigQuery and Snowflake the data moves bucket -> warehouse, not through rivet; the load is refused unless the destination is GCS (ClickHouse also reads S3/Azure). The map has no bucket->warehouse connection and does not say load is GCS-only for those two.

missing.what: CDC checkpoint file on disk (cdc.checkpoint, e.g. ./cdc/<table>.ckpt)
missing.why: The CDC resume position is saved to a local file, not the state DB; it is the store that makes MySQL/SQL Server/Mongo/Oracle resume, and claim_checkpoint guards it. The map's state store and capture sink never mention it.

missing.what: Google OAuth token endpoint and Secret Manager (gcp_auth / url_secret)
missing.why: rivet mints Google access tokens itself (service-account JWT grant to oauth2.googleapis.com) for GCS and BigQuery, and can read the source URL from Secret Manager; neither outside system is on the map.
